Method of Attack: Remote code execution (RCE) exploiting CVE-2022-47966 vulnerability in Zoho ManageEngine products
Use of PowerShell scripts to disable Microsoft Defender real-time protection and add exclusions
Deployment of remote access tools camouflaged as Windows Service Host service
Creation of reverse SSH tunnel using Golang protocol tunneling tool
Downloading and executing files from remote servers
Impacted Systems: Zoho ManageEngine products (at least 24 on-premise products including ServiceDesk Plus and Endpoint Central)
Attack Vector: Exploitation of unauthenticated pre-authentication RCE vulnerability CVE-2022-47966 in Internet-exposed ManageEngine instances
Indicators of Compromise: IP addresses targeting vulnerable ManageEngine instances including 221.226.159.22 (China Telecom Backbone Linux server)
IP 106.246.224.219 used to host malicious payloads
Use of PowerShell scripts disabling Microsoft Defender
Use of curl to download and execute files from remote servers
